Original_Text: Artificial Intelligence is transforming education by providing personalized learning experiences.AI tools can analyze student performance, identify learning gaps, and recommend suitable learning materials. It can also automate repetitive tasks such as grading and attendance, allowing teachers to focus more on students. AI-powered educational systems can provide instant feedback and support students at their own pace. However, responsible use of AI is important to protect student privacy and ensure fairness.
